message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most acclaimed and popular crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** (2017) – *2020 re‑release* | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A tense, psychological thriller that blends horror with crime‑investigation elements, exploring abuse and manipulation. |
| 2 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | Though more courtroom drama, it’s a gripping crime story about political dissent and legal intrigue. |
| 3 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish crime thriller that examines the consequences of false accusations and societal paranoia. |
| 4 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver | A historical crime drama that delves into medieval justice, betrayal, and the pursuit of truth. |
| 5 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino | A crime epic that spans decades, exploring organized crime, loyalty, and the moral cost of violence. |
| 6 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam | A stylish, fast‑paced crime comedy‑thriller that follows a drug‑deal plot twist. |
| 7 | **The Nightingale** | Jennifer Kent | Lily James, David Wenham | A gritty, atmospheric crime thriller set in colonial Australia, focusing on revenge and survival. |
| 8 | **The Invisible Man** (2017) – *2020 re‑release* | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A tense, psychological thriller that blends horror with crime‑investigation elements, exploring abuse and manipulation. |
| 9 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish crime thriller that examines the consequences of false accusations and societal paranoia. |
|10 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver | A historical crime drama that delves into medieval justice, betrayal, and the pursuit of truth. |

> **Note:** Some of these titles were originally released earlier but had significant re‑releases or streaming debuts in 2020, making them widely available that year. If you’re looking for strictly 2020‑original releases, consider titles like *The Invisible Man* (2017) re‑released, *The Hunt*, and *The Last Duel*.
